title: Dev mode not working in 1.3.0

Core CDI support enabled ``` **To Reproduce** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Clone this repo: https://github.com/rmpestano/myfaces 2. cd into `myfaces` and install it `mvn clean install -DskipTests` 3. cd into `myfaces/extensions/quarkus` and `mvn clean install` 4. cd into `myfaces/extensions/quarkus/showcase` and `mvn clean compile quarkus:dev` 5. access localhost:8080/index.xhtml **Screenshots** Following is a screenshot of the code which throws the exception: **Environment (please complete the following information):** - Output of `uname -a` or `ver`: `Darwin Kernel Version 18.7.0: Sat Oct 12 00:02:19 PDT 2019; root:xnu-4903.278.12~1/RELEASE_X86_64 x86_64` - Output of `java -version`: `openjdk version "1.8.0_232"` and `openjdk version "11.0.2" 2019-01-15` - GraalVM version (if different from Java): 20 - Quarkus version or git rev: 1.3.0.Final - Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`): `Apache Maven 3.6.2 (40f52333136460af0dc0d7232c0dc0bcf0d9e117; 2019-08-27T17:06:16+02:00)` **Additional context** * The issue **cannot** be reproduced in jar mode: `mvn clean package -DskipTests && java -jar target/quarkus-myfaces-showcase-1.0-SNAPSHOT-runner.jar` * Also **cannot** be reproduced in native mode (tested with graalvm 20): `mvn clean package -DskipTests -Pnative && ./target/quarkus-myfaces-showcase-1.0-SNAPSHOT-runner` * The application works in both jar and dev mode on quarkus 1.2.1.Final, you can check apache myfaces master repository: https://github.com/apache/myfaces
